_note: Minimum minutes between the arrival of one leg and the departure of the next, keyed by the transport pair. These are house rules, not published limits.

rail->intl_flight.note: Tokyo Station or Shinagawa to Haneda is 35 to 45 minutes door to door, and international check-in wants two hours. Anything under three hours from rail arrival to departure is a gamble on one delayed train.

rail->domestic_flight.note: Domestic check-in closes 20 minutes before departure, so two hours covers the transfer and one missed connection.

car->ferry.note: Ferries leave on time and the next one may be an hour away.

intl_flight_arrival->rail.note: Immigration and bags at Haneda in the afternoon peak can take 90 minutes.
